'''Pangasinan's 6th congressional district''' is one of the six [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Pangasinan]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 1987.<ref name="congleg">{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=April 30, 2020}}</ref> The district consists of the eastern municipalities of [[Asingan, Pangasinan|Asingan]], [[Balungao, Pangasinan|Balungao]], [[Natividad, Pangasinan|Natividad]], [[Rosales, Pangasinan|Rosales]], [[San Manuel, Pangasinan|San Manuel]], [[San Nicolas, Pangasinan|San Nicolas]], [[San Quintin, Pangasinan|San Quintin]], [[Santa Maria, Pangasinan|Santa Maria]], [[Tayug, Pangasinan|Tayug]], and [[Umingan, Pangasinan|Umingan]]. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Marlyn Primicias-Agabas]] of the [[Lakas–CMD]] (Lakas).<ref name="congmem">{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=April 30, 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1858438/5-from-pdp-laban-among-32-turncoats-to-marcos-party|title=5 from PDP-Laban among 32 turncoats to Marcos party|publisher=Philippine Daily Inquirer|date=November 12, 2023|accessdate=November 13, 2023}}</ref>
